description: This file defines a Dagger module for dependency injection related to Firebase Analytics in an Android app. It includes annotations for module installation, provides a singleton instance of FirebaseAnalytics, and binds an implementation of AnalyticsHelper.

classes.name: AnalyticsModule
classes.description: A Dagger module that provides Firebase Analytics instance and binds AnalyticsHelper implementation.

methods.name: bindsAnalyticsHelper
methods.description: Binds the implementation FirebaseAnalyticsHelper to the AnalyticsHelper interface for dependency injection.

methods.name: provideFirebaseAnalytics
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of FirebaseAnalytics using Firebase.analytics.
